en: Grain of Memory
Search Hyjal's destroyed Alliance camps for signs of Abigail Sawyer's father, Lawrence.

Before this... second life, I learned the grain of wood in my father's shop.

When war reached Hyjal, he stayed behind, crafting arms for those bound to the summit. I fled to Lordaeron. His final letter came from that mountain camp, and no word followed.

My death was likely no gentler than his. When I rose in Undercity, it felt like years had passed--but barely two had.

You look capable of the climb. Any remnant you find of my father, Lawrence Sawyer, would bring me solace.
Sawyer's Legacy
Take the Sawyer Family Ledger to Abigail Sawyer in Undercity's War Quarter.

Inside the wardrobe, a ledger records trades of hay, lumber, draft animals, and land. Other notes--personal and unfinished--are tucked between its pages.

The figures tell their own story: the Sawyer family was skilled at turning timber into weapons, tools, furniture, and wagons alike.

Thumbing through the pages reveals other kin of the family. Abigail Sawyer is listed among the relatives.

She would be very interested in this.
Chol'aruk the Ravener
Bring the head of Chol'aruk to Gur'ak in the Barrens.

You there, $c. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.

Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.

Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.

Blood and thunder, $c.

It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.$B$BIf these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the quilboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.

Impressive, $c. None will doubt my tales when I return to Orgrimmar with this grim proof of the existence of these abominations. Rest assured this glory is yours however, and I will speak loudly of your deeds.

Lok-tar!
Chol'aruk the Ravener
Bring Chol'aruk's Head to Bainham in the Barrens.

There are rumors of a colossal abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say it's so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.

Few believe such tales, but I do... because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.

Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me its head.
Notarized Claim
Take the Sawyer Family Ledger to Royal Overseer Bauhaus in Undercity's Trade Quarter.

I've added a note and my signature beside my name on the original page.

Take it to Royal Overseer Bauhaus at the Undercity Census and explain where it was found. He must know how it came to me while I remained at my shop.

You can be honest and say to him that Abigail Sawyer told another stranger her sob story and you happened to actually have the means to follow up on it.

Again, thank you for doing this for my family.
Wood Remains
Return the notarized Sawyer Family Ledger to Abigail Sawyer in the War Quarter.

I've stamped the pertinent pages for Abigail's records and updated our own documents.

Abigail will have to send a follow-up to the Royal Census when she intends to transport any of the property into Forsaken territories.

You may return her ledger and bring with it a reminder: Her contractual obligations to the War Quarter's commissary are not yet fulfilled, so she would be prudent to wait before attempting to act on any of these pre-war ownership claims.
Maerion's Misery
Bring $1oa Felhound Spikes to Maerion Thaelemaches in Dae'gun.

Left bleeding and abandoned--thrown aside so an army could flee. I was meant to die buying them moments. 

Instead, I was cursed to endure, forced to watch ever-burning demons finish what steel could not. This is my fate.

But something is changing. Horde and Alliance return to this desecrated mountain, and war stirs again.

My fury answers it. 

If yours does as well, prove it. Bring me two handfuls of felhound spikes from these Defiling Hounds.

The pain will align our wills.
Blind Vengeance
Climb to the top of the Horde Mage Tower and throw an Explosive Runeshard to signal for Maerion Thaelemaches to launch his attack on the demons.

The rune-etched shards are prepared. Dropped from high enough, they'll shatter upon impact, ripping through armor and demon flesh.

There's a tower overlooking this wasteland. It will give us the height we need.

We climb. I'll keep to the shadows and guard your flank.

When we reach the top, signal me by making the first throw. I'll bring ruin down on them.
Your First Riding Ram
Inspect the riding rams to choose your first mount.

Ah, it's a big day fer ya I see; here for yer first ram are ye?

These rams are the most steadfast and sturdy in all of Azeroth. They're fiercely protective of their rider. Aye, you'll have a hard time finding a more stalwart companion for yer journeys.

So, you have an important choice to make. You and yer ram will traverse the world together so choose wisely! Not to worry lad, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go see the rams and return to me when you've made yer choice.
Learning to Ride
Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Ultham Ironhorn.

Hello, $c! It would seem yer now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me ta teach ye how to ride a ram, for a fee o'course.

Veron will provide ye with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you'll be able to purchase any additional mounts ye would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but ye will have to find trainers for each.

Speak ta me when you have enough coin, and I'll teach ye all I know about riding rams.
Report to Danitha
Speak with Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
Danitha Morr has ordered you to report back to Bandarion Keep to receive additional training. Please make your way back to the keep as quickly as you are able.
Eluvi'ana
Deliver the Ancient Skyborne Blade to Ealaane Nimbuswalker to learn more about it.
Your First Horse
Inspect the riding horses to choose your first mount.

Greetings! Are you here to examine our horses?

These steeds are descendants from both the historical Lordaeron stock and our own local horses. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Don't forget, you and your horse will traverse the world together. I'm sure whatever choice you make will suit you best.

Go examine the horses and return to me when you have made your choice.
Your First Mechanostrider
Inspect the riding mechanostriders to choose your first mount.

Salutations! I see today is a big day indeed; today you will synchronize your biometrics to the rider detection protocol of your first mechanostrider! This protocol will help the strider distinguish you from other possible riders.

As such, you have an important choice to make. You and your strider will traverse the world together so choose wisely! Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the correct one.

Go examine the mechanostriders and return to me when you have made your choice.
The Cook in the Cage
Find a key to Wendel's cage, and a disguise for him to sneak out, within the Kurzen compound.

Hey! You! You have to help me! I was just out exploring the jungle when, all of a sudden, I was ambushed by these maniacs! I don't know what they plan to do with me, but I've heard talk of tigers and headshrinkers, and I don't want part in either!

I don't know how, but you have to get me out of here! Please! A key to this cage, a disguise to sneak out, something! Anything!
Returning to Port
Speak to Captain Aransas in Booty Bay.

Listen, I can't repay you right now, but I'm a cook on Captain Aransas' ship. I'll be sure to put in a good word for you when I get back to Booty Bay. You should speak to the captain when you get the chance. I'm sure she'll be grateful to have me back.
Essence of Seeping Slimes
Gather $1oa Seeping Slime Essence in the Shaper's Terrace.

If you're headed into Shaper's Terrace, I would ask a favor of you.

There are reports of slimes that live in the pools by the colorless Achromatic Crystal. I believe their essence could be of use in my experiments, and would like you to bring me some samples for study.

I will make it worth your while.
Tip the Scales - Keefer's Angelfish
Tip the Scales - Brownell's Blue Striped Racer
Tip the Scales - Dezian Queenfish
Learning to Ride
Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Jartsam.

Hello, $c! It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a saber, for a fee of course.

Lelanai will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts ye would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you all I know about riding sabers.
Now We're Cooking
Bring $1oa Savory Stag Sliders to Ortak Lomgok in Elderwild.

In addition to seeing to the spiritual needs of the people here, I feed them as well. I'm not exactly a trained cook, but after five years, I've learned a thing or two about preparing food!

I'm sure that folks here would love a taste of something different. I remember, before we assembled on the mountain, there was a goblin from Everlook who was serving platters of tiny, Savory Stag Sliders... I would love to taste one of those again. We have plenty of stags up here, too! Think you can cook some up?
Ancient Gurubashi Secrets
Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.

Lan'dalock and I have been discussing a recent development in the south seas involving an ancient Gurubashi ruin that has suddenly appeared off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.

Such a site has significant archeological value. We'd be highly interested in obtaining one of the idols that certain witch doctors amongst the ancient Gurubashi would use as a ritual focus for their blood magic.

Enter this "Drowned City" and recover one of these idols for us.
Material Assistance
If you are interested in helping Eldrun Stormbreaker in Ironforge, bring him an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond.

$n, the spirits weigh heavy, both materially and spiritually. I'm in need o' yer help. Deep within the depths of the Scholomance in Lordaeron lies the Great Ossuary, thick with shadows. I'm craftin' a device to cut that dark, but I lack the means to finish.

Bring me two diamonds: one Azerothian, and one Pristine Black. These are not trivial items, aye -- I just don't have the resources myself. Could ye provide me with the two diamonds?
The Darkreaver Menace

Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance.  Doing so will bring forth spirits you must fight. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver; defeat him.$B$BBring Darkreaver's Head to Eldrun Stormbreaker in the Forlorn Caverns, Ironforge.

Death Knight Darkreaver lords over the Great Ossuary in the Scholomance.  He threatens to twist the spirit realm to do his own bidding, and he must be stopped! This is where the scryer you helped make comes into play.$B$BUse the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to call forth Darkreaver's spirit minions.  Defeat the spirits and the death knight himself will appear. $n, bring me his head! Only his demise will reverse the damage done to the spirit realm!
Learning to Ride
Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Randal Hunter.

Hello, $c! It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a horse, for a fee of course.

Katie will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you all I know about riding horses.
Your First Horse
Inspect the riding horses to choose your first mount.

Greetings! Are you here to examine our horses?

These steeds are descendants from both the historical Lordaeron stock and our own local horses. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Don't forget, you and your horse will traverse the world together. I'm sure whatever choice you make will suit you best.

Go examine the horses and return to me when you have made your choice.
Blackmaw Magic
Recover a Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Blackmaw Hold.

The Blackmaw furbolgs in the mountains overlooking Azshara have been dabbling in dark magic. While a primitive people being corrupted by demonic magic is nothing new for Azeroth, Lan'dalock and I would like to study their spell foci.

Travel to the stronghold known as Blackmaw Hold and recover one of the Blackmaw Ritual Totems for us. Only the most powerful of the Blackmaw's shamans will be carrying one of these, so bring allies and take care.
A Worthy Endeavor
Speak with Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

The time has come, $n. As in life, paladins of the Forsaken are not complete until they are able to form a bond with a charger. This is no ordinary steed, this is a powerful spirit of retribution. $B$BSpeak with Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep to learn more. She will guide you on what to do next. The road before you will be difficult, but as our orc allies like to say--blood and thunder $G brother : sister;!
Due Sacrifice
Travel to Orgrimmar and get High Priest Zayus's Exorcism Censer. You will need to make a donation of 150 gold in order to secure it.

No worthy endeavor is completed without some sacrifice, and this first task requires just that.

You must acquire High Priest Zayus's exorcism censer for your task. Even though its use will be for good reason, due compensation must be given for it.

Proceed to Orgrimmar and speak with the High Priest Zayus there. Zayus will seek a..."donation" for the loss of his censer. It will be a small price to pay when all is said and done.
Exorcising Terrordale
Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the tormented spirits in Terrordale. When you have destroyed 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

I have added some dirt from the tainted ground of Terrordale in the Eastern Plaguelands to the censer. Go there and use this censer to find areas with the greatest signs of corruption. You'll know these areas by the green necrotic auras that rise up from the ground at the location where tormented souls congregate.

Use the censer to reveal these spirits. Free them from their torment. When you have put these souls to rest, return and we will discuss the next steps.
Acts of Mercy
Return the Exorcism Censer to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

With the blessings of the loa, take the censer. I be usin' it more than once to exorcise bad voodoo spirits, and it should serve ya well for the trials what be comin'.

You best be headin' back to Danitha now, $n. Ya quest continues with her.
Ott of Tarren Mill
Speak with Ott at the village of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

A paladin's charger needs a proper barding or it is little more than a mindless beast. The barding used by your charger not only needs to be of the finest materials possible, but must also be suitable for attunement to the spirit realm.

There is a smith outside of Tarren Mill that has done great work for our paladins in the past. He is a modest and unassuming orc, but his work is superb and is well-suited to our needs. Seek him out and commission him for this task.
Collection of Goods
Bring 40 Runecloth, 6 Arcanite Bars, 10 Arthas' Tears, 5 Stratholme Holy Water vials, and 150 gold to Ott in Hillsbrad Foothills.

We require several things for the barding--runecloth for the lining, arcanite bars for the plating, Arthas' Tears for the spiritual attunement, and Stratholme holy water for the spiritual imbuement. Lastly, I'd charge a modest fee for the labor and for the saddle and stirrups to go with the barding.

Bring me these materials, and I will be able to complete your barding. I'll get to work on the saddle while you work on gathering these items.
Ott's Finest Work
Take the Arcanite Barding to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep for inspection.

<Ott wipes the sweat from his brow and grunts at his work approvingly.>

There you are. My trade is mostly in the creation of weapons, but I believe that this might be some of my finest work nonetheless. I thank you for the trust you and your fellow paladins have shown me.

No doubt Danitha Morr will want to see the work for herself as well. Take your barding to her, and give her my thanks for allowing me to complete this commission on your behalf.

Lok-tar, $c.
An Offering of Vengeance

Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse. Nathanos Blightcaller in Eastern Plaguelands may be able to provide such a feed.

Travel to the Dire Maul in Feralas and slay Tendris Warpwood. Doing so will free the Ancient Equine Spirit. Feed it the special horse feed to soothe it. 

Lastly, give it the Arcanite Barding and hope that it is willing to provide the needed blessing.

A paladin charger's barding requires the blessing of a powerful equine spirit. In the ruins of Dire Maul the corrupted treant known as Tendris Warpwood has such a spirit imprisoned. Seek retribution on behalf of this spirit, and free it from its bondage. With luck, it may be willing to provide its blessing. 

To help ensure success, I'd also advise you to bring a special type of spiritually-attuned feed. Travel to Eastern Plaguelands and speak with the ranger known as Nathanos Blightcaller about this.
Blessed Arcanite Barding
Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

As the barding rests on the back of the Ancient Equine Spirit, it glows white hot. The air is thick with power for a brief moment, and then the barding disappears from the back of the horse and is now secure in your backpack.

Even through the leather of your satchel, you feel the heat still coming off of the saddle. It would seem that your offering of vengeance has been accepted, and the barding has been blessed. It's time to return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.
The Divination Scryer
Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

We now must assemble a Divination Scryer that will be vital for your final trial. The exorcism censer you used in Terrordale is the catalyst for it, and I should be able to fashion a suitable housing for the scrying device.

The last components needed, though, are two diamonds--one white, one black. This represents the duality of our nature as paladins of The Forsaken. These two will be the beacon by which the scryer will pierce the veil between the living and the dead.
Justice and Retribution

Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance.  Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver.  Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger.

Give the Spirit of Retribution and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.

In this satchel you will find the items you will need for your trial. Use the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to bring forth accursed spirits to face justice. The power of your judgements will be extremely valuable in this battle, so use them wisely.

Once you have dispersed these spirits, Darkreaver will appear. Defeat him and claim the lost soul of the charger. Show it the path of justice and retribution that you walk and with luck, it will take its place at your side.
Manna-Enriched Horse Feed

Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits for Nathanos Blightcaller in Eastern Plaguelands. The Argent Dawn is known as the sole purveyor of the biscuits. You'll also need to provide Blightcaller with 50 gold for his time.

So you need feed to give to the incorporeal spirit of a horse? Interesting.

Yes, I suppose I can help you with what you need. I have spent a considerable amount of time rearing beasts that are... let's say--no longer entirely of this world, and I know a thing or two about how to sustain them.

I simply need some of the spiritually-enriched biscuits that the Argent Dawn sells... and a small offering of gold. For my time, of course.
Learning to Ride
Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Binjy Featherwhistle.

Greetings, $c! You are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to pilot a mechanostrider, for a fee of course.

Milli will provide you with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough gold, and I will teach you about riding mechanostriders!
Learning to Ride
Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Kildar.

Mok'ra, $c. You are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride one of our wolves, for a fee of course.

Ogunaro will provide you with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough gold, and I will teach you about wolf riding.
The Coldbringer's Eye
Recover The Coldbringer's Eye from Razorfen Downs.

There is a servant of the Lich King that makes his home deep in the Death's Head quilboar lair known as Razorfen Downs. It is known to us that he makes use of a scrying orb to observe and direct the movements of his minions elsewhere.

With this artifact, we'd be able to hunt down the covert agents of the Scourge and put an end to them and the threat they pose to Kalimdor forever.

Go into Razorfen Downs to the lair of Amnennar the Coldbringer and retrieve the orb known as the Coldbringer's Eye for me.
Fragment of the Firelands
Recover a Fragment of the Firelands from Blackrock Depths for Alaana Stormwalker in Mulgore.

Muln tells me that there is a location in the deepest depths of a place called Blackrock Mountain where the barrier between Azeroth and the elemental plane has been damaged, allowing a myriad of elemental creatures from the realm of the Firelands to escape into this reality, including giants as large as an Anchor Pylon!

I'd very much like to study any fragments of material that could be gathered from one of these creatures. Would you brave the Blackrock Depths and recover a sample for me?
Blackmaw Magic
Recover a Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Blackmaw Hold.

The Blackmaw furbolgs in the mountains overlooking Azshara have been corrupted by dark and sinister magic. We do not know the full extent of the corruption and what impact it may have upon the elements in the area, but we hope to understand it better.

Travel to the stronghold known as Blackmaw Hold and recover one of the Blackmaw Ritual Totems for us. Only the most powerful of the Blackmaw's shamans will be carrying one of these, so bring allies and prepare for a difficult battle.
Learning to Ride
Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Xar'ti.

Ey, welcome $c! Ya now be seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride one of our raptors, for a fee of course.

Zjolnir will provide ya with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts ya would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but ya will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when ya have enough gold, and I will teach ya about raptor riding.
Learning to Ride
Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Velma Warnam.

Greetings, $c. It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a skeletal steed, for a fee.

Zachariah will provide you with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you desire. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you about skeletal horses.
Learning to Ride
Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Kar Stormsinger.

Greetings, $c. It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a kodo, for a fee of course.

Harb will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you about riding the noble kodo.
Learning to Ride
Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Genn Fairweather.

Hello, $c! It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a galestrider, for a fee of course.

I will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you about riding galestriders.
Philmor's Favor
Bring the Gatehouse Shipment to the stockroom entrance located in Trias' Cheese shop in the Trade District.

Every day this week we've been short dockhands.

Care to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?

Take this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.
You looking to fill a crate with our finest aged wheels?
Oh, dear. You think we want to carry that up the stairs ourselves? Keeping the valuables intact is your responsibility up until the point you drop it off.
Gatehouse Goods
Carry the Gatehouse Shipment up the stairs in Trias' shop and leave it outside the door.

Yes, it's only a flight of stairs, but if it's such a small ask, it should be no problem for you to finish the delivery yourself! 

Trias' Cheese isn't part of the Gatehouse or their stocking inventory, but our buildings share a floor.

Place the crate outside their stockroom door--the guard will send someone for a regular pickup. They will see the package arrival and carry it inside as they return to post.
You should at least try some of this aged cheddar. You can't stop eating it.

Yep. There's a reason that hinge opens inwards towards them, so they don't get the door blocked by people leaving stuff anywhere they please.

Consider us professionally acquainted, $c. 

We respect your business, and expect you to respect ours.
Bloodtalon Matriarch
Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.

All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.

The Bloodtalon are known for their cunning and swiftness, and make fine companions when raised from egg to adult.

Unfortunately adult raptors are very difficult to train, and I have tried to capture the Matriarch on more than one occasion. But she had become too dangerous of late.

Still I hope to preserve her legacy by raising her children as companions here in Sen'Jin.
Thank you, $N. I am happy we will be able to preserve her bloodline and raise them to be our allies. You have done a great service for our tribe.
Forgotten Loa Idols
Collect $1oa Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
Have you found our loa idols, $N? We must begin our rituals again soon.

You have done a great deed for our tribe today.

Unlike some tribes, our kinship with our loa is one of reverence and respect, and we owe them much.

I would not want the Darkspear to fall out of favor with them.
Reading Room
Bring the wrapped reading material to the Stormwind library.

Are you here to discuss the deeper meanings of our storied legends? No?

Well, after you're done looking around, can you carry this to the library for me? We're exchanging some of our less popular bodies of work for some more modern writing. I have a list of tomes I'm quite sure the librarian will be able to procure for us within our existing arrangement.

Complimentary club refreshments on us, if you help us out.
Please keep your voice down.

Let's see here. Roy's Book Club, isn't it? I recognize this wrap technique.$B$BWell, if he says this is what people want to talk about, it's all fine by me. The material we receive back is always in as good of quality as we loaned it, so we know they're treating it with respect regardless of how provoking the words may be.
Fang of Githyiss
Deliver the Fang of Githyiss to someone interested in the study of spiders in Aldrassil.
A fresh specimen from a beast of this size is quite a find. Perhaps someone in Aldrassil familiar with the study of spiders would be interested in the fang.

My, my. How I do love surprises, $N.

This specimen will surely help further my studies.
Shelf Picked
Find each of the reading materials located somewhere in the library and then return to Roy Lewells in Stormwind's Park.

I've checked our inventory and all of the selections Mr. Lewells has listed are currently available.

You will, however, need to procure them off the shelves yourself. Part of our librarian duty is vigilance, and for that, I will resume supervisory bookkeeping.

Returning with the material to Roy on his behalf will not mark yourself accountable for their return; as with his note you're serving as the book club's official courier. Their establishment shall carry that burden.

Good day, $n.

Bring the Torch of Dormant Flame to Olariaan Swiftburn at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands.

Even though we are in the realm of Skywall, this is still the elemental plane. The spirits of all four elements speak to us, if we deign to listen. One among us Windshapers is in particular attunement with the element of fire. A shen'dorei by the name of Olariaan Swiftburn.

Bring this to him at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands. You'll find it tucked away along the edge of the island, west of Valanaar.

Call of Fire
Slay Skypriest Faladiel in the Gustberry Lowlands and collect Faladiel's Heart.

There is an Al'Aketh Skypriest called Faladiel. He was once a caller of the flame and a stalwart Windshaper. Like so many Al'Aketh, he mortgaged his loyalty for power and his hands are now stained with the blood of his former brothers and sisters.

Meal Appeal
Visit Borstan's Firepit and tell him Thatog wants you to deliver Migi's lunch to him personally.

My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!

Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.

Of course. Migi's parents and I have an arrangement to give Migi a bagged lunch every day, but I can only ensure the boy gets his food if he actually comes in to pick it up.

Sometimes, he doesn't pick up his meal multiple times a week, and I wonder where he gets the energy to stay out and play.
Favorite Food
Bring Migi's Lunch to him behind Grommash Hold.

Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea. 

They made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. Take this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
I think we can win this one...

Borstan's Meats? Is that for one of us?$B$BOh!$B$BWow... this smells really good! Yummy.$B$BThanks for bringing me my lunch. I can tell what Borstan is going to be serving daily when my friends and I walk the road to Grommash Hold, by the smells alone. This tastes like my favorite, the sweetglaze! But it's different. I like the strong-flavored crumbs.$B$BIf it's going to be this tasty every day, I think we need to stop our game to take our lunch together!
Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected
Slay Alliance soldiers encroaching into the Barrens at the border to Dustwallow Marsh, then return to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.

Traveler, have you plans to head toward Dustwallow Marsh? I have heard mutterings that a few human soldiers have taken a stand at its border and are toppling the landmarks left behind by our tauren pathfinders.

Kill first, investigate later!

So the rumors were true! I expected as much, tensions have been rising along the eastern coast for some time. I knew it would only be a matter of time before conflict crept into our territory.

However, I am skeptical that we played a role in the tavern's destruction. Too many Horde civilians rely on that route for trade and travel. Perhaps you could investigate further if you find the time.

In any case, today's deed is a victory for the Horde, and a stern warning to the Alliance!

Collect $1oa Handfuls of Complicated Parts from the upper pirate camp south of Ratchet, then return to Wrenix the Wretched in Ratchet.

Hey, got a sec?

Turns out, scimitars double as screwdrivers in a pinch, and before I could redirect it home, it was already in pieces and scattered across their camp!

I need those parts back, and since this is a quick little retrieval mission, I'd wager your odds for survival are MUCH higher than the others. Whaddya say?
Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!

Whooooa! Nice one, pal! You saved me from another one of Gagsprocket's unbearable lectures on the cost of metal. More importantly, I can jump right into building my next prototype.

Uhhh, I didn't have a reward planned... Do you like boxes?

Deliver Eldrun's misplaced package.

What's that you've got there?

Let's see what I've got... totem carving tools... spare axe... some kind of goblin device? I didn't order that! Ah, I'll just send it back.

Er, uh... I mean... thank you for bringing all of this to me. Here's a little something for your trouble.
Shardtooth Pulling
Remove $1oa Elder Shardtooth from nearby areas, then return to Sarna Brownhorn.

The Shardtooth are becoming more rabid every season. They compete with each other and the predators of the wilds for what limited food sources they can reach.

Help them on their way. Cull the eldest of them.
Hate the Hatefury
Defeat a variety of Hatefury satyr at Sargeron in Desolace and then return to Aka'rai in Shadowprey Village.

Ever strike a deal with a satyr, mon?

I have. How could I resist? The promise of power, knowledge far exceeding what any ordinary tome could offer... all alongside an eager and charismatic minion. What more could I ask for?

Bah, of course they would never bend the knee to a mortal. I bargained when I had nothing, only to be cast aside with even less.

Now, I want revenge. Revenge against the Hatefury. Raid their camp to the northeast! Stain the dirt with their foul blood.

Maul or Nothing!

Alright, what's next... Black Lotus, Mountain Silversage...

Grorru--whaa?$B$BYou say Yelmak made this potion from speargrass and cattail with no other reagents? Goz will have one less thing to stress about now that you brought back his log book. Maybe now he can focus all his energy on gettin' back on his feet.

Either way you've done your side of the deal. Take this for your trouble.

Take this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.

For Othmar's crimes against the Dark Lady, placing him under that oozing specimen is the least he deserves.

Bring back the heads of Kuroma and Kamuro, and try to end them swiftly, skillfully, and with mercy.

Nature's Call
Collect $1oa Gnarlpine Totems and bring them to Tarindrella.

The Gnarlpine furbolg would not turn on their ancient allies so readily. We must learn more of their plight.

Search their abandoned homes for totems. If any survived the chaos of their departure, their engravings may tell us more of what happened here.

You'll find their camps along the western edge of the glen, though the grell and grellkin may have scattered them beyond.
Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!

Oh, it's even worse than I thought.

These engravings tell us that the Gnarlpine began having nightmares of being wiped out by some great shadow. Before long, that fear turned to rage--and the shadow to their former elven friends. To be aware of your own mind slipping away from you...

Our only hope is that this may help us better understand what is happening on Teldrassil. Thank you for your aid, $N.
